note: Per-config treatment for the NeoForge 1.21.1 migration (plan Phase 5). Ordered rules: the first match decides. 'regenerate' files are carried unchanged now and reconciled against the target mod's generated defaults at the first target boot (Phase 6): renamed or removed keys are reviewed then, intended values reapplied. Client-only defaults that a server cannot generate wait for the owner's first launch. tools/packwiz/tests/config_decisions.test.cjs enforces full coverage.
